faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DEGS Mungeli Aadhaar Supervisor/Operator recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the DEGS Mungeli Aadhaar Supervisor/Operator recruitment is 07 September 2026.

faq.answer: There are a total of 9 vacancies available for the Aadhaar Supervisor/Operator post in DEGS Mungeli.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed Higher Secondary (10+2) and possess a 1-year Computer Diploma from a recognized institute.

faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the form and submit it via post.

faq.answer: The job type for this position is contractual.

faq.answer: The selection process includes Document Verification, Claim Objection Resolution, Waiting List Preparation, and a Skill Test.
